For example, a 2BR resale unit at The Filmore costs about 8.3 – 9.3 billion VND and rents for about 35 – 40 million VND/month: annual revenue of about 450 million VND, equivalent to about 5% of the purchase price before costs. In return, assets in central locations usually hold their value well and are easy to resell.
